description:
Start a validated sweep. THIS IS THE ONE CALL THAT SPENDS: it puts the engine to work on every run the search describes, for minutes or hours, and there is no undoing it -- pause_sweep stops further work but does not give back what already ran. So say the run count out loud and get the person's agreement before calling it; a number they never saw is not one they agreed to. It returns immediately with the sweep queued or preparing, NOT with results: the runs land over time and get_sweep says how far along it is. A status of queued means it starts when the account's current sweep finishes, which is the sweep beginning and not a refusal.

[Access: pay 0.25 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
